scope: Standalone sanitizer CPU comparison and a separate paired installed full-path motion comparison. Neither is final release acceptance.
cpuDenominator: Current-thread user plus system CPU in the sanitizer call windows. Process CPU is a separate supporting counter. Neither is whole-capture CPU.
interpretation: Five fresh-process pairs per fixture show lower sanitizer thread CPU with disjoint process-mean ranges for subsequent calls. Every output passed complete bytes and independent pixel checks. Shared host contention limits wall-time interpretation. Actual capture, masking workers, ACK, persistence, composition and encode remain unmeasured for this candidate.

fullPath.decision: Keep the existing production implementation. The sanitizer CPU reduction has not established more reliable or faster full-path recordings.

limits: The Mac host is shared and busy. Paired ordering does not establish isolation.
One-repetition reports individually fail the three-repetition matrix requirement. Aggregate coverage is reported separately.
Uninstrumented phase CPU counters do not isolate PNG reconstruction. Prior excluded profiles may motivate a limiter hypothesis, but this matrix cannot establish a new causal limiter alone.
A numeric-passed result still requires normal-speed visual review. There is no publication or release authority.

normalSpeedReview.observations: Two baseline desktop videos played to their end at original speed. Sampled contact sheets show source progression, masks, labels, and the failed case missing a pulse on one side.
normalSpeedReview.playbackQuality: Browser counters reported dropped frames. Canvas sampling adds review overhead, and the host was shared. This does not establish a clean perceptual smoothness result.
